tickets.title: Build shared inheritance tracking ledger
tickets.text: Create a shared tracking ledger for Nadia Thimblefern’s inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions. Build it so Nadia can discuss the estate with Rowan Thimblefern using the same record set.
tickets.evidence: Nadia asked for a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions so she can discuss the estate with Rowan using the same record set; they agreed to build it by 2024-02-23.

tickets.title: Upload certified probate authority documents

tickets.title: Resolve estate bank access problem
tickets.text: Resolve Teacup Comet Bank’s rejection of Nadia Thimblefern’s online estate-account access attempt. The executor record did not match the bank’s internal file, preventing her from viewing recent estate cash activity.
tickets.evidence: Teacup Comet Bank rejected Nadia’s online estate-account access attempt and told her the executor record did not match its internal file, preventing her from viewing recent estate cash activity; the agreed follow-up on the estate bank access problem is due 2024-02-16.

tickets.title: Confirm controlling IRA beneficiary designation
tickets.text: Confirm the controlling IRA beneficiary designation for Alden Thimblefern’s IRA. Nadia brought a paper beneficiary copy that does not match the percentage shown in the custodian portal, and the controlling designation needs to be confirmed before inherited IRA paperwork is signed.
tickets.evidence: follow-up is needed, with no date supplied.

tickets.text: Organize the estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distributions for Iris Dewspindle of Amber Teapot Tax and Galen Nettlewhisk of Pocket Lantern Law before the next tax-planning conversation tied to the estate administration calendar.

tickets.title: Update Nadia’s successor fiduciary appointment
tickets.text: Update Nadia and Omar Pebblefizz’s 2016 personal estate documents to reflect that Alden Thimblefern’s death has ended his successor fiduciary appointment.

tickets.title: Develop inherited assets investment and spending framework
tickets.text: Develop a separate investment and spending framework for Nadia Thimblefern’s inherited assets. Account for retirement flexibility around age 62, college costs, cash reserves, and her preference not to blend estate proceeds into routine spending immediately.
tickets.evidence: Nadia wants a separate investment and spending framework for inherited assets that accounts for retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and her preference not to blend estate proceeds into routine spending immediately; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-15.
